limits: Current optimized version only. Baseline screenshots exist, but no baseline DOM count was run with this method.
Approximate inventory targets are reference goals; modal/row-data differences are explicitly identified.
Count all active view content, including below fold. Hidden/inert backgrounds, closed bodies/options, aria/alt/SR-only/tooltips are excluded.
Known identities/source narrative/units/dates/prices are replaced with data placeholders; no synthetic, AI, YouCam or caveat vocabulary blacklist is used.
One semantic owner is a heading, paragraph, label, control, summary, badge, notice or list item; inline formatting is joined. Unique and occurrence counts are both retained.
This is software copy measurement, not human readability, comprehension or usability evidence.
Read-only balance GET is authorized. No fresh preview or model/extraction task is submitted.
Inventory-comparable counts exclude only the explicit repeated wall/table/ledger selectors shown for that profile. Strict complete-view counts remain alongside them; scopes must not be interchanged.
Known data matches are exact text fragments. Functional labels with embedded fixture names remain conservatively counted when they are not exact data fragments.
Punctuation-only inline nodes are omitted by the semantic probe; normalized item text may omit a closing separator. Semantic boundaries follow the stated method.
Screenshots and raw run diagnostics are retained as private workspace artifacts at the listed paths; those paths are not public hosted links.
This report does not measure or substantiate the copy inventory estimate of 1170 to 610, nor a before/after readability improvement.
The 110% comparison uses target multiplied by 1.1 directly, without rounding the allowed integer count upward.
